records.rationale: Complete six-file initial keyslot manager patch examined. Native blk_crypto_profile supersedes the original callback-based key search and slot-index APIs: it keeps immutable-key identity, hashed lookup, refcounts, locked idle LRU/waiting, error wakeups and hardware program/eviction. Preserve native PM ordering, dynamic lock class, zero-slot profiles and removal of key pointers even on eviction error. Kconfig/build integration and request_queue crypto_profile are native. No obsolete keyslot-manager header or historical non-GPL exports are recreated.

Complete five-file initial device-mapper passthrough patch examined. Native dm-table/profile implementation retains intersection of all child crypto capabilities, explicit target opt-in, cloning and eviction on all children. Preserve later table-change capability checks and all-path SRCU release; the initial early return after dm_get_live_table must not replace the native cleanup. Old may_passthrough_inline_crypto and queue-owned ksm implementation are superseded by native DM_TARGET_PASSES_CRYPTO and crypto_profile.

Complete eleven-file synchronization patch examined. Native table-owned profile construction/destruction, child capability intersection, rejection of more restrictive replacement tables and monotonic queue capability updates represent the upstream conversion. Native linear/flakey feature flags, DM UAPI version and public headers remain current. Retained Android bow/default-key targets set DM_TARGET_PASSES_CRYPTO using the native feature model. Keep native PM, SRCU cleanup and error handling instead of copying old ksm code or restoring historical ioctl version numbers.

All unique remerge hunks across five paths examined. Native profile/header retain software-secret derivation and key-type intersection/superset/update behavior; native dm-table retains forwarding and gated wrapped callbacks. Native linear/flakey target flags replace the old conditional duplicates. Header declaration placement has no surviving functional requirement. Keep native field names, current source interfaces and table lifetime, with no historical KMI.

Complete nine-file encryption/casefold refresh examined. Native generic_ci_match now performs decryption, reports missing-key/allocation/decryption errors and handles strict invalid Unicode; F2FS preserves negative-error propagation and folio release for ordinary and inline directories. Mount-time generic_set_sb_d_ops supersedes old per-lookup dentry operation assignment in ext4/F2FS/UBIFS, retaining no-key-name revalidation. Keep native current helper signatures and the separately retained F2FS corrupted-dirent bounds check; no old per-lookup ops are restored.

Entire patch is a whitespace correction in documentation of the obsolete is_hw_wrapped field. Native key_type documentation and structure supersede that field; no executable change or security behavior needs porting.

Entire header-only merge cleanup examined. Native fscrypt header has the current single enabled declaration and disabled stub, no redundant old signature; its no-key-name documentation uses the corrected possessive. Later native parent/name-aware revalidation and mount-time dentry operations remain. No code change is required.

Full two-file secret-forwarding patch examined. Native GPL-exported blk_crypto_derive_sw_secret and device-mapper wrapped-operation dispatch provide the feature with block_device/size_t interfaces. Keep native all-path dm_put_live_table and callbacks installed only after wrapped capabilities intersect successfully. Native dispatch intentionally uses the first underlying device under its documented homogeneous-provider assumption, replacing old try-until-success logic; arbitrary incompatible providers are not certified.

Full two-file temporary refresh revert examined. The removal was explicitly to apply the upstream replacement. Current native GPL export and device-mapper wrapped-key forwarding remain; do not replay loss of functionality. Native first-device dispatch, capability gating and SRCU cleanup supersede the removed implementation.

Entire one-file addition examined. Retain the four-u64 named OEM array as generic vendor source customization storage in fscrypt_operations, consistent with the requested vendor infrastructure; omit adjacent historical KABI reserves. Native fields remain and all four in-tree filesystem operation tables use static designated initialization, zero-initializing omitted OEM members. No matching SDK consumer or runtime necessity was established, so this is conservative retention, not a claim of required SDK behavior or binary-layout compatibility. Trusted vendor code must respect const operation-table lifetime and cannot mutate read-only tables.

Entire two-hunk header helper addition examined and retained exactly: enabled builds return the attached context; disabled builds return NULL. It is a small generic source interface enabling callers without configuration conditionals, with no new allocation, ownership or userspace authority. Local C/header search found definitions but no exact helper call; necessity is unresolved and retention is conservative for ACK source compatibility. This does not establish absent external consumers or runtime validation.

Both unique remerge hunks examined. Current bio_crypt_clone retains native int return/error propagation and cloning documentation, plus Android skip-dm-default-key copying before conditional context cloning. No obsolete void return signature or suppressed allocation failure is restored.

This temporary rollback of a block merge is exactly undone by a9b70a2132e6. All 117 paths and 2521 changed lines have identical inverse patch content, including context, modes and paths after removing blob IDs/hunk offsets; stable patch IDs also match. This is an inverse-pair proof, not a claim of individually auditing all rolled-back upstream lines. Original merge f858d3a02f88 has no unique resolution; parent candidates are separately accounted. Do not replay the temporary removal of upstream block fixes.

This restores precisely the preceding 47c1260ea822 rollback, proven by complete normalized inverse-patch comparison across 117 paths, including literal changed lines/context/modes and matching stable patch IDs. Keep the resulting upstream baseline rather than replaying the canceling pair. Original block merge has no unique remerge delta; parent changes remain independently accounted. The comparison does not finalize unrelated historical commits.

inverse_pair_proof.normalization: Remove index blob-ID lines and hunk location ranges only; retain all patch body/context/path/mode bytes.

review_scope: Twelve full source patches, including all unique hunks of two merges; two additional commits resolved by complete inverse-patch proof. Native final code and configuration-facing helper/operation-table definitions examined.
validation: Source comparisons and unchanged source from build 105; no mounted filesystem, crypto I/O, module consumer or table replacement runtime test.
